methods.formula: Value = (assets in place + C − net debt) ÷ shares;  C = S·N(d₁) − K·e^(−rT)·N(d₂), d₁ = [ln(S ÷ K) + (r + σ²/2)T] ÷ σ√T, d₂ = d₁ − σ√T
steps: S = the expansion in year 5: the revenue it adds $2.87B (to $4.16B) × margin 8.0% × (1 − tax), as a growing perpetuity, discounted = $2.04B
K = capital to build it: $2.87B ÷ sales-to-capital 1.50 = $1.92B
σ = 72% (its stock, a year of daily closes), T = 5 years, r = 4.91% → C = $1.32B
assets in place = NOPAT −$1.25B ÷ WACC = $0; value = ($0 + $1.32B + net cash $1.34B) ÷ 527,460,000 = $5.03
